sql: select ticker, category, status, close_time, left(coalesce(title,''),60) as title, left(coalesce(settlement_source,''),40) as src, created_at from markets where ticker ~* '(CORN|WHEAT|SOY|COFFEE|SUGAR|COCOA|COTTON)' or title ~* '(corn|wheat|soybean|coffee|sugar|cocoa|cotton)' order by created_at desc
